title: Enough points from a cover by finitary slices
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] in the fixed universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be a set-indexed family of objects such that the coproduct of the associated sheaves of their representable presheaves $\coprod_{i\in I}h_{U_i}\to 1$ is an epimorphism in $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$. Here $h_U$ denotes the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(-,U)$, without any subcanonicity assumption. Assume that for every $i$, the slice site $\mathcal C/U_i$ has finite limits and every covering family in it admits a finite covering refinement. Then $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ has a set-indexed family of points $p_j:\mathbf{Set}\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ whose inverse-image functors jointly reflect isomorphisms.
